hero.description: SentryN3t Protection: Advanced NDR solution specifically designed to protect critical industrial environments. Total visibility, AI detection, and real-time response.

about.description: Founded in Northwest Spain with a clear mission: to shield the industrial productive fabric. We specialize in Industrial and IT Cybersecurity, developing our own proprietary tools.

features.team_desc: Computer engineers, chemists, and geomatics experts working together.
features.rd_desc: We develop 100% European technology tailored to real-world needs.
features.vision_desc: Convergence of technical and economic profiles for viable solutions.

product.description: Network Detection and Response (NDR) solution designed for modern industrial environments. Where IT loses visibility, SentryN3t takes control.

benefits.visibility_desc: Monitors OT and IT traffic, even between devices that do not pass through visible nodes. Eliminates blind spots in your network.
benefits.ai_desc: Detects anomalous behavior after a passive learning period. No complex static rules required.
benefits.interrupt_desc: Passive deployment via Port Mirroring or TAP. Does not interfere with production traffic or require agents.
benefits.sovereignty_desc: Technology developed entirely in the EU, complying with the most demanding privacy and security standards.

poc.title: Where do we start?
poc.description: We perform a Proof of Concept (PoC) on a critical line or zone without causing disruption. We validate detection and visibility in your real environment.
steps: Initial deployment and passive learning (2-4 weeks)
